decisions.reason: The About page required corresponding prize-copy changes, but its existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the prize-draw process item to one $500 winner every 100 sales and one $10,000 winner every 10,000 sales.
The Mission page required corresponding prize-copy changes, but its existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the relevant section with both revised prize rules.
The Big Block mechanism is directly affected, but its existing message-158 MODIFY already records one winner, a draw every 10,000 sales, and removal of the prior approximate-interval semantics.

The Small Block mechanism is directly affected, but its existing message-158 MODIFY already records one winner, a $500 pool target, a 100-sale interval, and removal of the prior approximate-interval semantics.

The source changes prize counts and draw intervals while explicitly preserving the net giveaway amount; it does not change the mint price, per-sale allocation, commission, or active prize-pool destinations.
Changing winner counts and draw intervals does not alter Chainlink VRF, ticket weighting, eligible ticket holders, on-chain selection, fairness, or verification.
The revised prize sizes and intervals do not change which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or active and expired tickets transfer on resale.
The source does not change the mint-number basis, permanence, display surfaces, sharing methods, or resale behavior of referral codes.
The source changes block-prize parameters but does not alter the $5 no-referral commission, its triggering condition, or its allocation to a random existing NFT holder.
The source changes prize frequency and winner count but does not change the requirement to expose Small Block and Big Block ticket counters, permanent badges, or the referral-code attribute.
The block-prize adjustment does not change the current Project Rebuild name or the planned BooksOnChain name.
Although secondary sales remain counted toward prize draws, the source does not change whether secondary royalties are enforced or their flat $10 amount.
